subject: Re: Acme Analytics POC - success criteria & week 3 status

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Acme POC - recap & proposed M.A.P.

Hi Jordan — great meeting today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan for the POC so we keep momentum: 

Summary of objectives
- Validate Redwood inference for their real-time recommendations pipeline (latency target < 120ms p95 on 8 token prompt).
- Evaluate quality vs. baseline model on conversion uplift (A/B with control).
- Measure cost/per-token under realistic throughput (100 req/s steady-state).

Success criteria (proposed)
- p95 latency <= 120ms on a c5/GPU equivalent (we'll run on your staging cluster first).
- Recommendation NDCG improvement >= 5% over baseline on the provided eval set.
- End-to-end reliability: >= 99% request success rate during a 48h soak.

Immediate next steps (week 0)
1) Redwood to provide POC matrix + SOW draft (attached) — owner: me — by Fri 6/12.
2) Acme to confirm success criteria and provide eval dataset + staging credentials — owner: Jordan — by Fri 6/19.
3) SE kickoff (Marcus) to validate test harness and perf tooling — target kickoff call week of 6/15.

Attachments: redwood-poc-matrix.xlsx, redwood-sow-draft.pdf

If that looks right I'll lock the timeline and get Marcus and our infra team looped for a tech kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa
